items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: Sounds like that fellow Phil Schaap.

ctx.x: What we liked and what we played. And that influence is with me today, because I’m not a four-beat banjo player. I’m really — I play the banjo kind of like the way a drummer plays the drums, you know, that kind of thing. And then as I got farther into the music and got influenced by some of my colleagues, I began to appreciate the older stuff and the older musicians, and of course I was way behind the power curve in terms of my knowledge of this kind of thing, and some people I know are collectors and they know…
Sounds like that fellow Phil Schaap.
